messages.author: 119ce10fdb5bc5ad
messages.subject: Directory path error on glimmer
parts:
Hi!

I am very excited to try out Shiny, and have a nice little test app running on my own computer now.
I have uploaded the test app to my glimmer directory, but when I enter the address in my browser, it says "Page not found".
As I see it, it can be one of two things:
1) I have entered the address wrong (example: "http://glimmer.rstudio.com/mydir/app1/)
2) It will take a while before the directory will be accessible online.

Any suggestions?

Cheers!
Carsten

messages.author: 119ce10fdb5bc5ad
messages.subject: Re: Directory path error on glimmer
parts:
Hi again.
I finally found the problem. As you can see below, I named the directory "app1", but it should be "ShinyApps". 
Hope this can help others to get started. It works great now :-)

Cheera
